instruction: Repair {{entry}}. Read one JSON array of closed events {id:string,seq:integer,key:string,op:'put'|'delete',value?:string}. ids and sequence numbers must each be unique, seq must be a nonnegative safe integer, and keys/ids must be nonempty. put requires exactly one string value; delete forbids value. Validate all events, sort by seq, fold into a map and output one JSON object line with surviving keys sorted by Unicode code point order. Treat __proto__/constructor as data. Malformed or unknown fields exit 2 without any stdout.
